stepBody: As part of a separate transportation analysis, Rachel wants to survey a sample of UC Berkeley students on how many times they traveled out of Berkeley in the past month. She decides to divide the population into groups based on their year (e.g., freshman, sophomore, junior, senior, and graduate students) and then conduct a simple random sample of size ng among each group g, where ng is proportional to the number of enrolled students at UC Berkeley in group g. What type of sample is this?
